question: As of 31 July 2025, which is the second most successful team in Ranji Trophy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Karnataka** is the **second most successful team** in the history of the Ranji Trophy as of **31 July 2025**, having won the prestigious cricket tournament multiple times. 
• In the history of the Ranji Trophy, Karnataka has achieved **8 championship titles**, showcasing consistent performances over the years. 
• The team has produced numerous iconic players, including **Rahul Dravid, Anil Kumble, Javagal Srinath, and KL Rahul**, who have made significant contributions to Indian cricket. 
• Karnataka's success in the Ranji Trophy stems from a robust cricketing infrastructure and a focus on nurturing young talent
